ai.title: Project understanding agent replaces workspace profiler on GPT-6 Luna
ai.summary: The workspace profiler subsystem is renamed to project understanding, with the agent ID changed from `freebuff-workspace-profiler` to `freebuff-project-understanding` and its model switched from DeepSeek V4 Flash to GPT-6 Luna to prevent project files from reaching DeepSeek's API. The agent is built at runtime from a backend-served template, runs four reading rounds before forcing a `set_output` call, and offers only `list_directory`, `glob`, `read_files`, and `set_output` tools. The SDK gains two new `RunOptions` flags: `confineFileToolsToProject` (backs a new `ProjectFence` that refuses paths outside `cwd` via symlink-resolved containment) and `refuseNonTextFileReads` (refuses non-text extensions and NUL-siffed binaries via a shared `non-text-files` module). This is one of five distinct changes; others include a new `DESKTOP_PROJECT_UNDERSTANDING` analytics event, a `broad-roots` guard that blocks home/Desktop/Documents/system paths, and a cost-estimation helper pinned to GPT-6 Luna's OpenRouter standard-tier list prices.

changes.what: Renamed the workspace-profile module to project-understanding, switched the agent model to GPT-6 Luna, and tightened its tool set to four read-only tools.

Added the SDK-side project-understanding client, a due-check/report API against `/api/v1/project-understanding`, and a `countProjectFiles` helper that respects read limits and the non-text guard.

Added `confineFileToolsToProject` and `refuseNonTextFileReads` to `RunOptions`, a new `ProjectFence` that rejects paths outside `cwd` as written or through symlinks, and per-tool enforcement in `handleToolCall` for `code_search`, `list_directory`, `glob`, and `read_files`.

ai.title: GLM 5.3 Flash removes promotional badge from model catalog
ai.summary: The `GLM_V53_FLASH_MODEL` row in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` drops its promotional badge, reflecting the end of the temporary pricing period on 2026-10-13. The comment beside the removal notes the price is now 20 Freebucks, as defined in `freebuff-freebucks.ts`. This prevents the CLI and Web pickers from rendering the 'Promotional' tooltip on the model row now that the deal has concluded.
ai.evidence: The hunk in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts` removes the promotional object from `GLM_V53_FLASH_MODEL` and replaces it with a comment stating the promotion ended on 2026-10-13 with the price at 20.

eli5.text: The temporary discount badge that marked a popular AI model as being on sale was removed from the shared model list. This update targets the developers who use the Freebuff coding assistant, ensuring the special price label disappears now that the promotion has ended. You will no longer see the "Promotional" hint next to this model in the app, and the price simply settles to its standard rate without any special deal notice.

facts: The prompt section of a `lean` compaction policy (LEAN_COMPACTION_POLICY): context is scarce, so read narrowly, without doing less of the task.

entries.title: Agents update: base3
entries.summary: New files: `agents/base3-haiku-5-5-evals.ts`, `agents/base3-haiku-5-5-lean-evals.ts`, `agents/lean-context.ts`, `evals/buffbench/haiku-lean-report.ts` (+1 more).

ai.title: Add lean context budget prompt to base3 agent for 100k models
ai.summary: A new `lean` flag on `RootCompactionPolicy` (defined in `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts` with `maxContextLength` of 110k) triggers a context-budget section in the base3 agent's system prompt. The section, generated by `leanContextGuidance` in the new `agents/lean-context.ts`, instructs the model to read narrowly and keep every request under 100k prompt tokens. This allows eval pairs (added in `agents/base3-haiku-5-5-lean-evals.ts`) to isolate the performance impact of the budget on Claude Haiku 5.5, which OpenRouter prices at a premium above 100k tokens. Supporting changes add `ContextLogEntry` tracking in the buffbench runners and a new model picker placement for the 100k-context row.
ai.evidence: New file `agents/lean-context.ts` exports `leanContextGuidance`, which `agents/base3.ts` now imports and appends to the system prompt when the `lean` flag and `maxContextLength` are set on the compaction policy. `common/src/constants/compaction-policy.ts` adds `RootCompactionPolicy` and `LEAN_COMPACTION_POLICY` with `maxContextLength: 110_000`. New eval files `agents/base3-haiku-5-5-evals.ts` and `agents/base3-haiku-5-5-lean-evals.ts` pair a full-context run with a lean-budget run of Claude Haiku 5.5 in buffbench, and `evals/buffbench/runners/runner.ts` introduces `ContextLogEntry` to capture per-request usage and compaction events.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show when the `lean` flag will be set on production catalog rows for end-user sessions.

changes.what: Introduce `RootCompactionPolicy` and `LEAN_COMPACTION_POLICY` to support a 100k prompt token budget.
Add `lean-context.ts` and update `base3.ts` to inject context-budget guidance when the `lean` policy is active.
Add `ContextLogEntry` tracking and a cost-reporting script to measure prompt sizes and compaction frequency in buffbench runs.
Place the new Claude Haiku 5.5 100k-context model row at the top of the Powerful picker section.
Retry the `bun install` step in the Freestyle VM sandbox to handle transient registry tarball extraction failures.

eli5.text: The internal testing harness now tracks how much information the coding assistant is given with each request and when it compresses old conversation history. This allows the engineering team to compare the assistant's performance when it works within a strict, smaller memory limit versus a generous one, ensuring the compact mode does not reduce the quality of the work. This change is for the development and evaluation tools used by the Freebuff team and does not alter how the application behaves or what you see in your daily use.
